== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Aethertech]] eyes are advanced optical implants or technological components that serve as highly sophisticated visual processors. These devices can manifest in various colors, most notably orange, red, blue, and pink, and may be integrated into a person's artificial skin or implanted at the back of the neck. They are capable of performing extraordinary feats, such as scanning for threats, viewing data invisible to the naked eye, and perceiving various spectrums of light. Some models can even project a target's immediate future or allow a user to look into [[Subspace]]. While some users possess older models, others utilize superior hardware that allows them to outperform standard visual systems. Beyond individual use, these eyes can be part of larger machines or deployed as independent entities to monitor environments.}}
